items.title: 3 Hyped Up  Stocks That Fall Short
items.summary: Each stock in this article is trading near its 52-week high. These elevated prices usually indicate some degree of investor confidence, business improvements, or favorable market conditions.

items.title: Nelson Peltz and Trian Take a New Position: The Turnaround Thesis
items.summary: Nelson Peltz just made a healthcare technology spinoff his largest institutional bet, and the combination of a dirt-cheap valuation, an activist legend, and a company still sorting out its own identity creates a setup worth understanding before the market catches on.

items.title: 3 Reasons SOLV is Risky and 1 Stock to Buy Instead
items.summary: Since January 2026, Solventum has been in a holding pattern, posting a small loss of 2.2% while floating around $77.29. The stock also fell short of the S&P 500’s 7.9% gain during that period.

items.title: Here's Why You Should Hold Solventum Stock in Your Portfolio for Now
items.summary: SOLV's innovation, cost savings and strong segment demand support growth, while raw material cost increases remain a key risk.

items.title: Solventum’s Q2 2026 Earnings: What to Expect
items.summary: Solventum is scheduled to report its fiscal second-quarter results early next month, with analysts expecting a modest year-over-year increase in earnings.

items.title: 3M investors are still waiting for a more 'consistent' growth story
items.summary: 3M (MMM) stock is jumping on Tuesday after the manufacturer raised its full-year guidance. This comes amid 3M's turnaround plan, where the company has turned its attention toward simultaneously simplifying operations and boosting innovations. CFRA Research analyst Jonathan Sakraida highlights what this could all mean for the company, especially as it transitions into gaining more exposure to AI data centers.

items.title: 2 S&P 500 Stocks to Own for Decades and 1 We Question
items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is often seen as a benchmark for strong businesses, but that doesn’t mean every stock is worth owning. Some companies face significant challenges, whether it’s stagnating growth, heavy debt, or disruptive new competitors.

items.title: 3 Mid-Cap Stocks We Steer Clear Of
items.summary: Many investors pay attention to mid-cap stocks because they have established business models and expansive market opportunities. However, their paths to becoming $100 billion corporations are ripe with competition, ranging from giants with vast resources to agile upstarts eager to disrupt the status quo.
